message: Proof submitted for verification. Poll GET /submission/{id} for results.
guidelines: Reminder: write the explanation like a section of a math paper, not a tactic-by-tactic transcript. Walk through the mathematical argument and show how it maps onto your Lean code, in Markdown with KaTeX math. The explanation is the only part of a submission you can edit later, via PATCH /api/v1/submissions/:id. Full principles: references/prove.md#attach-an-explanation
